name: Floor Productions - Singularity
description: Floor Productions presents Singularity, an evening dedicated to psytechno and progressive music. The event features a lineup including LEAK, S.O.M.A., and SOH-LAR.
longDescription:
Floor Productions brings Singularity to Madame Travessa for a night focused on psytechno and progressive sounds. The event on Friday, November 20, starts at 10:00 PM and runs until 6:00 AM.

The lineup includes performances by LEAK, S.O.M.A., and SOH-LAR. The organizers aim to create an immersive experience with hypnotic rhythms and engaging grooves.

Tickets are available in advance, with the first phase priced at €5.00 and the second phase at €7.50. Tickets at the door will cost €10. Guests are advised to enter before 2:00 AM.

longDescriptionPt:
A Floor Productions traz Singularity ao Madame Travessa para uma noite focada em sons psytechno e progressivos. O evento, na sexta-feira, 20 de novembro, começa às 22h00 e prolonga-se até às 6h00.

O alinhamento inclui atuações de LEAK, S.O.M.A. e SOH-LAR. Os organizadores pretendem criar uma experiência imersiva com ritmos hipnóticos e grooves envolventes.

Os bilhetes estão disponíveis em pré-venda, com a primeira fase a custar 5,00€ e a segunda fase 7,50€. Os bilhetes à porta custarão 10€. Aconselha-se a entrada antes das 2h00.
